Hall of Thanes (13-18, under Ironforge) is the new Alliance low dungeon. Night Elves can take the new Stormwind Harbor - Auberdine ship and join the Stormwind route (playhub: join Duskwood ~20). Cozy Sleeping Bag chain starts at 14 (Alexston Farmstead, Westfall) and crosses both continents.

Excavation Site: Wetlands dungeon 27-30 (ConquestCapped; other sites list 24-29, 26-31, 26-33). New ship loop Menethil -> Southshore -> Auberdine -> Menethil links Wetlands, Hillsbrad and Darkshore.

Dustwallow, Badlands, Swamp of Sorrows are the alternatives in the same band.

Reached from southern Desolace through the Valley of Bones (Nijel's Point is the nearest Alliance flight path). wow.gg 38-45, pcgames 40-45, ConquestCapped 35-45; Blizzard has not published a range and no flight master was found in zone data. wow.gg main 35-40; alternatives Dustwallow, Badlands, Swamp of Sorrows, Riverglades, Shen'dralas. The Drowned City (35-40) off STV.

Clear each new dungeon once for quest XP.

forever_tips: XP curve is unchanged from Classic: 4,084,700 total XP to 60; levels 1-30 are only ~12% of it and the halfway point is level 48 (ConquestCapped, Warcraft Tavern). Blizzard (Kris Zierhut): 'We did not change the experience curve'; new zones are a different path, not a faster one.
XP moved from kills to quests: open-world mobs below your level give 4-20% less XP per kill (same-level mobs unchanged), and AoE grinding is reduced. Do every quest at least once.

Dungeon XP: dungeon mob XP started far below Classic; Oct 1 beta halved the extra dungeon-quest bonus; Oct 8 raised dungeon kill XP ~20% and made party XP for low-level kills depend on each player's own level; Nov 8/9 hotfix raised dungeon kill XP another 50%. Dungeon quests still pay well above Classic (Defias Brotherhood final step 2,600 Classic vs 6,175 after the cut). Run each dungeon once with a full quest log; repeat runs pay less than questing.
Nov 13 hotfix (GameLeap): if a dungeon enemy is trivial (gray) to even one party member, the whole party gets 0 kill XP, so group near your own level. Boosting is penalised.

XP-to-gold conversion at level 60 is removed in Forever, so do not hoard quests for 60; turn them in as you go. Since the Nov 10 hotfix most quests of quest level 48+ award gold (some types excluded: valuable-item rewards, repeatables, trivial quests).

Rested XP doubles kill XP only (not quest turn-ins): 5% of a level per 8 h in an inn/capital, capped at 150% (1.5 levels). Well Fed +5% kill XP; Camp Tent tops up rested; Cozy Sleeping Bag (chain starts at 14, crosses both continents) gives up to +3% and counts as rested.

New transport: Stormwind Harbor <-> Auberdine ship (new); one-way loop Menethil -> Southshore -> Auberdine -> Menethil (new, skips the low-level Dun Algaz/Wetlands run); Steamwheedle Port (Tanaris) <-> Powderfuse Port (Riverglades) goblin ferry (new, both factions, ~2 min); Valanaar skycutters to Dalaran (Alliance Skyborne, then portal to Stormwind) and to NW Mulgore/Skywatcher Plateau (Horde Skyborne).

Riverglades access: Alliance walks in from north Redridge (fast, next to Alliance zones). Horde route is a considerable detour (Barrens -> Thousand Needles -> Shimmering Flats -> Gadgetzan -> Steamwheedle Port ship) or a hostile overland entry from the Badlands. Powderfuse Port reportedly has no working flight master: ride to Rog'mar (Horde FP Grakna) or Farholde Keep (Alliance FP Gretchen Mayberry). Farholde Keep is a full town (no need to return to Stormwind).

Riverglades: ~150-200 quests across both factions; most Krol'dok Stronghold quests unlock after the zone's main story, so run the dungeon once near 42-44. Horde prep list (GameLeap): 10 Chunk of Boar Meat, 10 Heavy Weightstone, 12 Iron Bar, 4 Thick Leather.
Mount Hyjal flight paths: Everlook <-> Tainted Foothills <-> Summit of Eternity (both factions). Taxi may need the intro Hyjal story first (ExpCarry).
No flying; Apprentice Riding 100 gold at 40, Journeyman 1,000 gold at 60. Pick up every flight path; set hearth at the hub you use most.

Dungeon quests cannot be shared; take the quest before inviting (joining a group can change your layer); max 5 instance entries per hour; Group Finder does not summon, only Warlock Ritual of Summoning.

Small XP wins: capital-city intro and delivery quests pay ~1,000-1,200 XP for a minute or two (ConquestCapped). Shatterspear Trolls no longer give XP (Nov 10). Respawns were sped up in starting zones (Nov 2 notes).

Skip advice is mostly about dungeons, not zones: ConquestCapped says Alliance should skip Ragefire Chasm, Shadowfang Keep, Razorfen Downs and Razorfen Kraul (only 2 quests) and that Scarlet Monastery is weak for Alliance; Horde should skip Hall of Thanes and SFK unless Undead, RFK optional. No source publishes a zone skip list; games.gg says to do Riverglades before Swamp of Sorrows if you arrive under 38, and wow.gg says Hyjal does not replace the 50-55 zones. Horde has no hub in the Wetlands.

Source conflict: gfinityesports (Nov 11) gives Riverglades 32-40 with hubs 'Riverwatch Outpost / Mudspire Enclave' bordering Ashenvale. That contradicts every other source and the wiki (35-45, Farholde Keep / Rog'mar, east coast of the Eastern Kingdoms), so it was disregarded.
Horde can also enter Riverglades on foot from Swamp of Sorrows through Redridge Pass (warcraft.wiki.gg, timesaver.gg). This is shorter than the Tanaris boat when already in the Eastern Kingdoms.
